name: Forcepoint
evidence_summary: Forcepoint sources evidence managed Secure SD-WAN, cloud central management, zero-touch deployment, MultiLink resilience and security controls.
cost_model: Quote-based appliances/software/subscriptions; managed SD-WAN positioned but pricing public transparency limited.
key_differentiators: FlexEdge Secure SD-WAN combines secure SD-WAN with strong DLP and data security heritage from the wider Forcepoint portfolio.
MultiLink resilience and zero-touch deployment with cloud central management.
Strong story for buyers prioritising data security and DLP as a procurement criterion.
best_fit_for: Enterprises with strong data protection and DLP requirements (regulated industries, government).
Organisations wanting secure SD-WAN where data security is the primary decision driver.
Buyers consolidating DLP with SD-WAN under one vendor.
watch_outs: Smaller SD-WAN market presence than the leading platforms.
Full SASE platform completeness has partial public evidence; SSE module depth should be confirmed.
Managed delivery is partner-led; co-managed and white-label support require partner validation.
verification_notes: Capability matrix sourced from Netify internal vendor research (May 2026). Status grades reflect public source evidence only. Confirm via RFP. Qualitative fields (differentiators, best fit, watch-outs) are Netify editorial synthesis based on the evidence summary and capability profile; review before publishing. Extended dimensions (regions, clouds, AI, resilience, deployment speed) are indicative desk research grades from June 2026; confirm via RFP.

ai_capability.note: AI Mesh for data security; risk-adaptive protection scores user behaviour in real time.

resilience.note: Cloud SSE with regional redundancy; Secure SD-WAN appliances deploy in HA pairs.
